cause: Two GLB bodies that never complete occupy both staging reservations after a camera change. The tile library cancels unused QUEUED requests, but retains LOADING requests; normal geometry LRU eviction intentionally does not interrupt protected staging.

before.twoStalledChildren: No errors after 25 seconds; both reservations remained occupied.
before.missingHeaders: No rejection or transport abort after 25 seconds.
before.openBody: No rejection or stream cancellation after 25 seconds.

policy.scope: Both catalog and legacy verified geometry/image asset transports. Catalog manifest preparation is outside this watchdog.

after.twoStalledChildren: Existing load-error handling rejects each asset and removes it through the public cache callback; pending and staging counts become zero, the 100-byte committed test parent remains, and a new neighborhood can reserve a slot.
after.retryBound: Failed resources remain denied in the current camera epoch; the transport does not start a retry loop.
after.slowProgress: Three chunks arriving 20 seconds apart complete successfully after 60 seconds total.
after.cleanup: Timers clear after verification, corruption, cancellation and timeout. Empty chunks do not extend the timer. A non-settling cancellation promise cannot hold the failed request open.

limits: Uses fake-time streams and the real cache/admission classes with the existing load-error removal path. It does not claim a browser network-throttling result, whole-city graphics acceptance, or a new geometry ownership policy.
